description: A named `dynamic` (with children and a `finally:`), a named `each` loop, a named model-mode `if`, an inline `use`, and a `reflector` are all disabled by the profile. Proves one skip node each with nothing underneath (no child nodes, no `iter_N`/`collected`, no `condition_result`, no child events, no `finally:` run, no reflector planning call, no `use` child run) and no replies consumed.
